description: The chart illustrates the accuracy percentages of three models, Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, in two categories, MMAU and MMAR. The categories are represented on the horizontal axis, with the model names listed in a specific order. The vertical axis is labeled "Accuracy (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, and tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model has two bars, one for MMAU and one for MMAR, colored in dark blue and purple, respectively. The MMAU bars have values of approximately 50, 62, and 65 for Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni, respectively, while the MMAR bars have values of around 30, 35, and 57 for the same models. The bars are grouped by model, with the MMAU and MMAR bars appearing side by side for each model. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars, but the models are listed in a consistent order across both categories.
